    toDate(timestamp) AS day,
    sum(revenue_cents) AS revenue
FROM events
WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
  AND revenue_cents > 9950
  AND timestamp >= '2024-01-01'
  AND timestamp < '2024-02-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day ASC
WITH FILL 
    FROM toDate('2024-01-01') 
    TO toDate('2024-02-01')
    STEP INTERVAL 1 DAY
INTERPOLATE (revenue AS if(revenue = 0, lagInFrame(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY day), revenue))
